notes.title: Vivid Tale joins the Steam Debut Festival 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43373449/8150dffeb760c63d3b63e998f0ccb6d101fda512.jpg[/img]

Greetings!  

[b]Vivid Tale[/b] is part of the [b]Steam Debut Festival 2025[/b] — an event where debut games take the stage for the very first time! We’re excited to invite you to experience our cozy RPG with turn-based battles and a deep story in the free demo available now.

This is our first major game, and we’re proud to share it with you — even if for now it’s only as a demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3122130/Vivid_Tale_Demo/

Thank you for supporting indie developers and debut creators in the games industry.  
Try the demo, share your impressions, and join the discussion in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/REsGgmh6Fq]official Discord[/url] community!

[u][h2]Publisher’s Note[/h2][/u]  
Discover new genres, fresh ideas, and one-of-a-kind worlds crafted by passionate debut creators from around the globe — all as part of the Steam Debut Festival 2025.

These games are more than just first projects — they’re honest, heartfelt creations built with the pure love of making games.

notes.title: Update #5 for the Demo is Out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43373449/de12e0f2a3708d9e07311b4ac64da77ddfd36cc6.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings![/h3]

The latest update for the demo is now available!

Key Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed several minor bugs.
[*] Updated the start screen with a new "About Full Version" tab, social media links, and a wishlist button.
[*] Added a custom cursor.
[*] Introduced transition animations between main menu screens.
[*] Added sound effects for card interactions and menu elements.
[*] Menu elements now highlight on hover.
[*] Dimmed "old" cards in dialogues.
[*] Trimmed the opening monologue.
[*] Sped up the appearance of new cards in dialogues.
[*] Enabled drag-and-drop functionality for skill cards onto heroes and enemies in combat.
[*] Reworked some attack animations in the first battle.
[*] Added camera movement when using skills and items.
[*] Activated the inventory menu and added the ability to change character equipment.
[*] Reduced the prologue map size by ~130 tiles.
[*] Added small environmental details and "cloud shadows" to the prologue map.
[*] Introduced background sounds for the street and hall locations.
[*] Replaced the "romantic" dialogue with a battle.
[*] Updated attack animations in the Goose Fight.
[*] Adjusted the volume of certain lines and replaced some voiceovers.
[*] Added "Thank you for playing the demo" cards after the final monologue.
[/list]

Development is ongoing! Our next major goals are a full-fledged skill menu and a large-scale rework of the combat system.


[h3]Thank you to everyone playing the demo![/h3]
We encourage you to share your impressions in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2256240/discussions/]Steam Community[/url] or join our  [url=https://discord.gg/EpN9NGsYQP]Discord[/url] to ask questions and chat with us!

notes.title: Demo Update #4
notes.content:
Salute!

So, here’s the final autumn update! We’ve got damage numbers popping up during battles, a character menu, and not one but two amazing new tracks — fanfare and final boss fight music for the demo.

— Added pop-up numbers during battles
— Added a character menu
— Added 2 new music tracks
— Made minor adjustments to the system menu
— Minor localization fixes

notes.title: Demo update #3
Demo Update #2
Demo update!
"Vivid Tale" Demo is released!
notes.content:
Greetings!
So, we're ready to present to you a tiny demo version of our game "Vivid Tale".
It's been made with sweat, tears, and a tons of love!

We recommend playing it in the evening, with dim lighting and a cup of tea on the table.

And no, don’t worry, it’s not a CCG or a card-based roguelike, even though the screenshots might try to deceive you 🙂

This demo is the prologue to the main story. It tells the tale of Seaver, a young Idol of Stribog. Together with his mentor Ratmir, he arrives in the capital to participate in the ceremony of passing power from the old tsar to the young tsarevich Bogdan. You’ll battle a monster, meet a colorful group of Idols and foreign chosen ones, try to woo a boyar’s daughter, and catch a sly goose. It’s a celebration all around! But… It seems storm clouds are gathering on the horizon.

There’s still a lot of polishing, reworking, new mechanics, and other interesting stuff ahead that we’re developing for the main game, and we’ll be adding them to the demo as they’re ready. We really want to make the game as good and accessible as possible, so we’ll be eagerly awaiting your feedback. Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts, no matter how critical they may be 🙂

Everyone who has worked and continues to work on this game has put a piece of their warmth into it, and we hope it resonates with you.

Take care and have a great day!
